thread:
Maya (CEO): Quick weekly update — thanks for the sprint push. Three priority items: 1) Private GA launch targeted for Tue next week — ops checklist is in the Console, please review and flag blockers. 2) On-call rotation change: pilot moving infra on-call to 7-day shifts starting 2026-05-05; details and FAQ below. 3) Data retention policy change: non-prod logs default retention reduced from 90d -> 30d to cut costs; exceptions via compliance ticket.

Jordan (VP Eng): Huge thanks to the launch crew. Question on the 7-day shift — do we want an overlap/handoff window and what’s the expected paging delta?

Sam (SRE Lead): We'll own runbook updates. Recommend a 30m overlap for handoffs by default, and we'll run a two-week shadow before firm cutover. Early estimates show paging volume may rise ~12% during rotation transitions; I'll share the telemetry.

Priya (Dir Product): For GA readiness: feature flags will be at 10% canary PST for the first 3 hours, then a staged ramp if latency and error rates hold. Note: QA found a minor embedding regression; patch v1.2.1 is deployed to canary — monitoring visible in Optimize.

oncall-bot: New schedule published: https://console.redwood/schedules/infra-oncall — shifts begin 2026-05-05. PagerDuty integration updated.

Liam (Finance): Heads-up: committed capacity discounts updated for Dedicated customers. Billing teams will apply credits starting next billing cycle; customer communications draft coming.

Maya (CEO): Action items — Jordan/Sam: confirm handoff doc + overlap procedure by EOD Wed. Priya: ensure rollback gates + canary checklist live in the Console. Liam: have customer billing notice ready for review by Fri. Quick sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to sign off. :rocket:

Jordan (VP Eng): Acknowledged. I'll post the handoff doc in #eng-oncall and tag owners.

Sam (SRE Lead): Creating the handoff doc PR now; will link here when ready (expect within 18h).

Priya (Dir Product): Uploading the canary checklist and prompt test set to the Console under LaunchPlaybooks.

Maya (CEO): One more operational ask — for sev2+ incidents, please aim for an initial postmortem draft within 48h. We'll highlight adherence in the next all-hands. Thanks team. :memo:
